column1: # Uniques whose art Exiled Exchange 2's item database lacks, has stale (GGG redrew it since), gives
# as their base's, or which it doesn't list at all: the art the trade site's listings of each show
# (their item's `icon`, the market collector's stored listings and fetches of 2026-10-12), which
# is the art the game draws -- what the price check recognizes an unidentified unique by. The
# English name, the Russian one (the trade site's) and the art URL's path after
# https://web.poecdn.com/gen/image/, a tab apart; a unique drawn differently on its bases (Grand
# Spectrum on each gem) has a line for each, the art the panel shows first. generate_item_refs.py
# puts the art in place of the database's, or adds the unique when the database has no such row.
